title: FIRST-USER:154
text: - **Worker upkeep:** install concise project-scoped execution instructions for Yoke and Platform. When planning and finishing any item, inspect the prototype topics it touches. Add missing concepts/surfaces, update affected teachings and links, mark uncovered or stale teaching and report remaining gaps with evidence and exact prototype references through existing work reports/field-notes. Changes to behavior carry their necessary teaching updates; broader gaps go to steering. Verify live behavior before marking it live. Review only affected topics, not the whole catalog on every item.
